instruction: Candid photographic medium shot of a cozy living room at night. On the left, the woman with short gray hair (R1) in a yellow shirt and beige vest slow-dances, tilting her head and smiling at the man with glasses (R2) on the right. The man (R2) in a brown jacket holds her hands, looking at her. In the blurry foreground, two glasses of white wine sit on a table under warm, soft indoor lighting.
